about: Loop patterns observed in the reference games and generalized. Designers compose a game's loop from one primary pattern plus 1–2 secondary patterns.

timeScales.day: Only when daily outcomes matter (live games, box office days). Provide +week/+month and next-event skips.
timeScales.week: Default for operating businesses (box office, routes, restaurants). 52 ticks/year.
timeScales.season: Sports with phases (preseason, regular season, postseason, offseason) mapped onto week ticks.

loops.name: Operate → Learn → Expand
loops.short: Each tick: units earn or lose money; the player adjusts price/capacity/marketing on exceptions.
loops.medium: Every few months: open/close units, buy capacity assets, hire key people.
loops.long: Years: build a network/portfolio, climb tiers, acquire rivals, survive cycles.
loops.feedback: Unit P&L, utilization, satisfaction, market share, network visualization.
loops.failure: Cash runway runs out; overexpansion during downturn.
loops.victory: Tier milestones; market leadership; valuation targets.

loops.name: Develop → Commit → Reveal → Exploit
loops.short: Advance projects through gates; respond to development events.
loops.long: Build a slate, franchises, a reputation for hits; catalog/licensing revenue.
loops.feedback: Estimate bands that narrow; the reveal moment (opening weekend, reviews); long tail revenue.
loops.failure: Overcommitting to flops; financing deadlines missed.

loops.name: Source → Diligence → Invest → Manage → Exit
loops.short: Monitor portfolio; respond to capital requests and inbound deals.
loops.long: Fund cycles, exits, compounding net worth, empire structure.
loops.feedback: IRR/MOIC, valuation marks, deal outcomes vs anti-portfolio.
loops.failure: Overleverage in a downturn; bad acquisitions.

loops.name: Acquire talent → Develop → Compete → Reset
loops.short: Weekly games/competitions; lineup and tactics on exceptions.
loops.long: Dynasty building, facilities, staff, legacy and records.
loops.feedback: Results, standings, player growth, scouting reveals.

loops.name: Sign clients → Grow careers → Negotiate deals → Keep them
loops.medium: Negotiate contracts/endorsements; recruit new clients; manage relationships.
loops.long: Agency reputation, roster of stars, poaching wars.
decisions: when to take less for loyalty
loops.feedback: Commission income, client satisfaction, career trajectories.

pacingRules: A meaningful decision should be available at least every 2–4 ticks in the early game.
Interrupting (critical) events: at most ~1 per in-game month on average.
Each year should contain 2–4 scheduled moments of truth (openings, earnings, awards, season end).
Routine outcomes are summarized in a digest, not individual popups.
'Advance until next event' must exist when the tick is shorter than a month.
